svg.title: dbt lineage, read from the manifest
svg.text: dbt lineage, read from the manifest
A dbt build here runs 99 nodes: 7 models, 89 tests, 3 seeds. Generated from dbt/target/manifest.json, so it cannot describe a graph dbt does not have.
